_comment: Every metric and every recording rule referenced by the rules and dashboards must be listed here with where it comes from. tests/test_prometheus_configs.py fails on anything that is not, so a copy-pasted or invented metric name cannot reach main.

ALERTS.description: Synthetic series generated by the alerting rules, one per active alert with its state.

up.description: 1 when the scrape of a target succeeded, 0 otherwise.

probe_success.description: 1 when a blackbox probe succeeded, 0 when it failed. Raw input of the availability SLO.

probe_duration_seconds.description: End to end duration of a probe.

probe_http_status_code.description: Status code returned by the probed HTTP endpoint (http prober only).

probe_http_duration_seconds.description: Time spent per HTTP phase of the probe: resolve, connect, tls, processing, transfer.

probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry.description: Unix timestamp of the earliest certificate expiry in the probed TLS chain.

node_cpu_seconds_total.description: Seconds the CPU spent in each mode, the input of every saturation calculation.

node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes.description: Memory available for new workloads without swapping.

node_memory_MemTotal_bytes.description: Total physical memory of the node.

node_filesystem_avail_bytes.description: Bytes available on the filesystem holding the Prometheus TSDB and Loki chunks.

node_filesystem_size_bytes.description: Total size of that filesystem, used with the available bytes to compute usage.

process_start_time_seconds.source: prometheus, alertmanager, loki, blackbox_exporter, node_exporter, synthetic_target
process_start_time_seconds.description: Start time of the component process. Changes are how the container restart alert detects a restart without cAdvisor.

prometheus_rule_evaluation_failures_tota.description: Counter of rule evaluations that failed; a non-zero rate means alerts are silently not firing.

alertmanager_notifications_failed_total.description: Counter of notifications the alertmanager could not deliver.

synthetic_http_requests_total.description: Requests served by the synthetic target, by path and status code. Only known paths are labelled.

synthetic_http_request_duration_seconds_.description: Histogram buckets of request duration; le=0.3 is the latency objective boundary.
Number of duration observations, the denominator of the latency SLI.

synthetic_http_inflight_requests.description: Requests being served at scrape time: concurrency as the saturation signal.

recording_rules.slo:availability:budget_remaining_ratio: Remaining part of the 99.5% / 30d error budget.
recording_rules.slo:latency:ratio_rate5m: Share of requests served under 300 ms over 5m.
recording_rules.slo:latency:ratio_rate1h: Share of requests served under 300 ms over 1h.
recording_rules.slo:latency:ratio_rate2h: Share of requests served under 300 ms over 2h.
recording_rules.slo:latency:ratio_rate6h: Share of requests served under 300 ms over 6h.
recording_rules.slo:latency:ratio_rate1d: Share of requests served under 300 ms over 1d.
recording_rules.slo:latency:burn_rate:5m: Latency budget burn rate on the 5m window.
recording_rules.slo:latency:burn_rate:1h: Latency budget burn rate on the 1h window.
recording_rules.slo:latency:burn_rate:2h: Latency budget burn rate on the 2h window.
recording_rules.slo:latency:burn_rate:1d: Latency budget burn rate on the 1d window.
recording_rules.slo:burn_rate:5m: Availability budget burn rate on the 5m window.
recording_rules.slo:burn_rate:30m: Availability budget burn rate on the 30m window.
recording_rules.slo:burn_rate:1h: Availability budget burn rate on the 1h window.
recording_rules.slo:burn_rate:2h: Availability budget burn rate on the 2h window.
recording_rules.slo:burn_rate:6h: Availability budget burn rate on the 6h window.
recording_rules.slo:burn_rate:1d: Availability budget burn rate on the 1d window.
recording_rules.slo:burn_rate:3d: Availability budget burn rate on the 3d window.
recording_rules.lab:requests:rate5m: Request rate per path, computed once for the dashboards.
recording_rules.lab:probe:success_rate5m: Probe success rate per probe job.
